text: Competition has a way of making people have a fulfilling life
llm_text: I agree — competition can motivate and drive progress, but it isn't automatically good. Without fair rules, oversight, and a moral framework it can lead to cheating, burnout, and inequality. As a parent and researcher I want kids and coworkers pushed to improve, but also taught integrity and teamwork so competition builds people up instead of tearing them down.
